messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD-4821 for service inference-edge-eu-west (p95 latency 2.4s, error rate 4.8%). Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-4821

pagerduty-bot: page fired -> on-call: @sam taylor. Escalation policy: eng-oncall -> SRE-lead. Initial priority: high.

sam taylor: acked PD-4821, taking ownership. Starting quick triage.

sam taylor: quick context: new deploy (staged canary) started 2024-06-03T18:22Z. We were shadowing ~10% traffic to the 'quant-runtime-v2' image in eu-west. Observed spike in tail latency and 5xx from the shadowed pool.

ana rao: @sam do we have pod logs/ooms? is this a kernel/driver issue or app-level error?

sam taylor: grabbing logs now. One snippet: ```
Jun 03 18:24:31 quant-node-3 quant-service[pid]: runtime: oom kill, process crashed
Jun 03 18:24:31 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 21457 (quant-worker) score 1234
Jun 03 18:24:33 quant-node-3 kubelet: Pod restarted (oom)
```

pagerduty-bot: autopage will escalate to SRE lead in 5m if not acknowledged by an escalation policy member.

tobias m: looks like OOMs correlated with the new quant kernel flags (--kv-cache-size=auto). Several nodes (quant-node-3, quant-node-5) showing repeated restarts and increased memory usage in top.

sam taylor: I'm pausing the rollout and dropping shadow traffic to 0%. Command: ```kubectl rollout pause deployment/quant-runtime -n inference; curl -X POST https://router/api/shadow/scale -d '{"eu-west":0}'``` Will confirm when router shows 0%.

kevin li: I'm on router changes. Shadow routes set to 0% for eu-west, changes propagated to edge proxies. Confirming no live traffic diverted to canary.

sam taylor: confirmed shadow traffic 0% at 18:31Z. Metrics: p95 back to baseline ~300ms -> 340ms, error rate dropping toward normal.

ana rao: any customer visible impact? Were primary routes affected?

sam taylor: primary traffic not impacted — only shadow. However, internal background jobs and healthchecks were hitting the new runtime (we missed a healthcheck-target override) which amplified the OOM cascade. No external customers reported errors.

maria g: I'll open a rollback PR to revert the kernel flag change and prepare a hotfix image without the new memory allocation heuristic. tagging @tobias m for build/test.

tobias m: ACK. I'll scrub node-level logs and collect kernel dumps. Will run the quick memtest build on a staging node.

sam taylor: PD status -> mitigated. Keeping incident open while we validate rollback image in a small canary without shadowing. Action items: 1) revert kernel flags (maria), 2) add explicit healthcheck-target override to deploy pipeline (ana), 3) add golden regression test for memory consumption during quant init (tobias).

pagerduty-bot: PD-4821 acknowledged by sam taylor. Incident state: acknowledged -> monitoring.

sam taylor: will follow up with a short blameless postmortem and timeline. Leaving this thread open for any followups. :thumbsup:
